candidate_evidence.quote: sintilimab (one anti-PD-1 antibody same as nivolumab approved in China) plus bevacizumab administered in a low dosage schedule

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: with a clinical relapse or circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA)-level relapse of glioblastoma (GBM)

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: -To evaluate the correlative biomarkers based on TISF ctDNA.

role_evidence.quote: Sintilimab (One Anti-PD-1 Antibody) Plus Low-dose Bevacizumab for ctDNA-level-relapse and Clinical-relapse Glioblastoma

flag.reason: Bevacizumab (established GBM therapy) is given at a low-dose schedule named in the title; coded established_therapy_experiment, but if treated as a second investigational agent it would be a candidate (experimental_combination).

biomarkers.biomarker_other: tumour in situ fluid (TISF) ctDNA relapse dynamics

source_quote.quote: Subjects with ctDNA-level-relapse glioblastoma before clinical relapse, determined according to the dynamics of TISF ctDNA.
-To evaluate the correlative biomarkers based on TISF ctDNA.

coder_notes: Registry intervention name says 'Tislelizumab plus Bevacizumab' but the brief summary, description and dose text say sintilimab (TYVYT is sintilimab); coded as sintilimab. Both cohorts receive the same drugs; cohorts differ by timing of treatment (ctDNA-level relapse vs clinical relapse), so there is no control arm. Cohort assignment by ctDNA dynamics is coded as an enrichment biomarker (not matched to a drug).
